page.overview:
Who is Duncan Kincaid?

Unnamed Son (Deceased)}} Duncan Kincaid is a mercenary and covert operations team leader, a friend of Zora Bennett, and a major character in . At some point, Duncan resided in Suriname. He usually works with Zora in war-torn areas.

At some point in Duncan’s life, he met a woman named Amelia with whom he had a son. However, their son died under unknown circumstances, causing Duncan great pain. This led to him and Amelia being apart. During Duncan’s career, he met Zora Bennett who he became good friends with.

At an unknown point, Duncan moved to Paramaribo, Suriname, South America. There, he started smuggling goods via his boat, the Essex, with his crew consisting of LeClerc, Nina and Bobby Atwater. He established the Van Dijk's bar as his base of operations.

In 2027, Duncan is contacted by Martin Krebs, an employee for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering, to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert, a former InGen island, to retrieve blood samples from the three largest dinosaurs. Some time later, Zora, Martin and paleontologist Dr. Henry Loomis arrived at Van Dijk's Bar & Grill to discuss the upcoming mission. Initially, Duncan refuses to take them to the island as his boat is new and he hasn’t pay it off yet. However, Krebs agrees to double Zora’s pay and she would distribute the money between Duncan and his crew. Duncan reluctantly agrees, and the team leave for the island; he tells them their expedition must be discreet as they will be heading to prohibited waters, even though there won’t be much authorities patrolling there since people generally avoid that part of the Carribean Sea.
